extension.description: Add any number of Stremio addon manifests and browse their catalogs, metadata, streams and subtitles from inside Kodi.
extension.disclaimer: This add-on provides no content. You are responsible for the Stremio addons you install and the content they provide.
extension.news: v0.10.3 - With autoplay on: "Show Playable Streams" in context menus and a Streams tile in Extended info. Removing an episode from Continue Watching also removes its show from Next Up until you watch more. v0.10.2 - Continue Watching shows descriptions, cast and details. v0.10.1 - Create, rename and remove hubs (Organise catalogs context menu); settings buttons open reliably. v0.10.0 - Hubs (Movies, TV Shows, Anime, More) with Genres; Organise catalogs; tidy names; poster tiles. v0.9.0 - Widgets folder, combined Continue Watching, time left, show progress, hide watched, pre-warming, open on next episode. v0.8.7 - Actor/director searches: AIOMetadata people search when enabled, otherwise Cinemeta added. v0.8.6 - Extended info: icon action tiles; one-line scrolling detail rows. v0.8.5 - Settings shortcut to show/hide Kodi's ".." entry. v0.8.4 - "Filter by Genre" and "Next Page" poster tiles. v0.8.3 - Optional genre filter when browsing catalogs (not on widgets). v0.8.2 - View chooser with previews; default view also on later pages. v0.8.1 - MDBList watchlist: add/remove from Kodi, Watchlist list, library follows it.
